salaries.description: Average monthly nominal salary in GEL, by sex or sector, NACE Rev. 2 economic activity, year, and quarter. Includes annual observations.
salaries.grain: One row per sex/sector × economic activity × year × quarter

employment.description: Labour-force levels and rates by economic status, year, and region.
employment.grain: One row per economic status × year × region
employment.unit: Thousand persons for levels; percent for rates

inflation.description: Consumer price index with the same month of the previous year equal to 100, by region, COICOP group, year, and month.
inflation.grain: One row per region × consumption group × year × month
inflation.unit: Index (same month of previous year = 100); year-over-year inflation rate is value - 100

cpi.description: Consumer price index level with the 2010 average equal to 100, by region, year, and month. Use for deflating nominal values to constant prices.
cpi.grain: One row per region × year × month
